newsitem.title: USA: BetzDearborn sees better Q3 sales activity.
newsitem.headline: BetzDearborn sees better Q3 sales activity.

text.p: BetzDearborn Inc said Thursday it expects continued improvement in sales activity in the third quarter as it fixes computer problems related to its integration of W.R. Grace's DearBorn business in June 1996.

The company said it has "largely resolved" system problems related to the integration that were distracting its sales people. As a result, it saw a resurgence in sales momentum in the second quarter with five percent growth over the first quarter, BetzDearborn said.
The company reported second quarter diluted earnings per share of $0.64 compared to $0.71.
Excluding integration costs, diluted earnings per share for the quarter were $0.81 compared to $0.71.
Its sales for the quarter rose to $322.4 million compared to $210.1 million.
